findings.camera: Active approximately 60Hz throughout approach. Captured frame counter advanced normally; empty_polls remained 617. Pad visible in debug preview. No camera stream stall explains this flight's failure.
findings.explanation: Intermittent marker detection prevented stable marker qualification and source transition. Mission remained APPROACH until OFFBOARD was left.

debug_JPEG_redetection.limitations: Annotated 10Hz JPEG, not original raw input. Marker regions are clear of overlays. Demonstrates threshold-window sensitivity but does not prove a future closed-loop landing.

fix.policy: Restore OpenCV 3/13/23-pixel adaptive threshold windows through stack-supplied configuration. Marker PnP and level-pad mode retained; no safety limit relaxed.

deletion_scope_authorized_by_user: Only this failed flight's Jetson bag/manifest/sync sidecars and ML copy including both webcams, plus temporary extracted JPEGs. Earlier successful flights and operational campaign history retained.
retained_evidence: This numeric diagnosis only; no flight payload copy is retained by this analysis.
